intro:
Easy kanji questions for kids!
Pick the answer from 4 choices
and enjoy learning step by step!
description:
Enjoy simple Japanese kanji quizzes made for kids and families.

Each question uses a 4-choice format, so players can answer without complicated controls. Children can check kanji readings and meanings at their own pace, while parents can join in and think through the answers together.

How to play is easy:
・Read the question
・Choose the correct answer from 4 options
・Keep going and review kanji little by little

This is a good choice for children who are starting to learn kanji, families who want a light learning activity, or anyone looking for a quick Japanese word quiz.

Play alone for a short study break, or enjoy it together as a family. Make kanji feel more familiar through easy, game-like questions.
